parts_head.eyebrow: Different and the Same · 同與不同
parts_head.en: What is different, and what is the same?

parts.meta_en: Different · the width follows the pressure
parts.meta_zh: 不一樣・粗細跟著輕重
parts.text_en: In the model, the line in 永 goes from 0.3 to 2.5 cm wide. Press for thick, lift for thin.
parts.text_zh: 在模型裡，「永」的線從 0.3 公分變到 2.5 公分寬。按下去粗，提起來細。

parts.meta_en: Different · one width all the way
parts.meta_zh: 不一樣・從頭到尾一樣粗
parts.text_en: The tip is hard, so the line keeps almost the same width. All that is left to decide is where the line goes.
parts.text_zh: 筆尖是硬的，所以線幾乎一樣粗。剩下要決定的，只有線放在哪裡。

parts.meta_en: The same · same places, same lengths
parts.meta_zh: 一樣・位置一樣、長短一樣
parts.text_en: Lay the brush character under the pencil one. Every pencil stroke runs down the middle of a brush stroke.
parts.text_zh: 把毛筆字墊在鉛筆字底下。每一條鉛筆線，都走在毛筆筆畫的正中間。

parts.meta_en: The same · same first stroke, same last
parts.meta_zh: 一樣・第一筆、最後一筆都一樣
parts.text_en: Both tools write 永 in five strokes, in the same order. You learned why order matters in Lesson 4.
parts.text_zh: 兩種筆寫「永」都是五筆，順序一樣。為什麼要照筆順，第四課學過。

lessons.parts_note_en: All four pictures are drawn from the same stroke data as the 3D model. Tap a card to watch it happen.
lessons.parts_note_zh: 四張小圖和 3D 模型用的是同一份筆畫資料。點卡片，就在模型裡看它發生。

slim.lead_en: Here is a character written with a brush. Pull the slider to the left and its thick parts shrink until every line is as thin as a pencil line. Watch the three numbers: only one of them changes.
slim.lead_zh: 這是毛筆寫的一個字。把滑桿往左拉，粗的地方會慢慢縮小，直到每一條線都和鉛筆線一樣細。看看下面三個數字：只有一個會變。

spot.lead_en: On the left is a model written with a brush. On the right, someone copied it in pencil, but one stroke is too short, too long, leaning, or in the wrong place. Tap that stroke. The nine-square grid is there to help you compare.
spot.lead_zh: 左邊是毛筆寫的範字。右邊是用鉛筆照著寫的，可是有一筆太短、太長、斜掉了，或位置跑掉了。把那一筆點出來。九宮格就是用來幫你比位置的。

pad.lead_en: Trace the pale red model, first with the pencil and then with the brush. With the pencil, the line is the same width however you move, so all your attention can go to position. You can also change the grid: a 田 grid, a nine-square grid, or a 米 grid.
pad.lead_zh: 照著淡紅色的範字描寫，先用鉛筆，再換毛筆。用鉛筆的時候，不管怎麼動，線都一樣粗，所以可以把注意力全部放在位置上。格子也可以換：田字格、九宮格或米字格。

tips.en: Before each stroke, look at the grid. Where does the stroke start? Where does it end?
tips.zh: 每寫一筆之前，先看格線：這一筆從哪裡開始？到哪裡結束？

tips.en: Write 永 with the pencil. Then switch to the brush and write it again on top. Do your two characters line up?
tips.zh: 先用鉛筆寫「永」，再換毛筆在上面寫一次。兩個字疊得起來嗎？

tips.en: Turn the model off and write from memory. Turn it on again and check your positions.
tips.zh: 把範字關掉，憑記憶寫一次；再打開範字，檢查每一筆的位置。

links_head.en: Lessons that help with this one

links.en: Why Do We Write Strokes in Order?
links.zh: 筆順與結構：為什麼要先橫後豎？
links.note_en: Stroke order is one of the things a brush and a pencil share.
links.note_zh: 筆順，就是毛筆和鉛筆共用的東西之一。

links.en: How Is Chinese Calligraphy Different from Western Calligraphy?
links.zh: 中文書法和西洋書法有什麼不同？
links.note_en: Another pair of tools: a soft brush and a stiff broad-edge pen.
links.note_zh: 另一組工具的比較：軟的毛筆和硬的平頭筆。

links.en: What Are the Four Treasures of the Study?
links.zh: 文房四寶是什麼？
links.note_en: Where the series began: brush, ink, paper, and inkstone.
links.note_zh: 這個系列開始的地方：筆、墨、紙、硯。

culture_cards.eyebrow: Pencils and Taiwan · 鉛筆與台灣
culture_cards.title_en: A pencil with no lead in it, two letters on its side, and writing in Taiwan's schools
culture_cards.title_zh: 沒有鉛的鉛筆、筆桿上的兩個字母，還有台灣學校裡的寫字課
culture_cards.lead_en: Two things about the pencil from an encyclopedia and a pencil maker, and two about writing from Taiwan's own documents.
culture_cards.lead_zh: 兩件關於鉛筆的事，來自百科全書和鉛筆製造商；兩件關於寫字的事，來自台灣自己的文件。

cards.en: No lead in a pencil
cards.body_en: An encyclopedia explains that a pencil is a thin rod of graphite, often called the “lead,” though it contains none of that metal. Modern pencils still use a mixture of graphite and clay. Taiwan's Ministry of Education dictionary says the same: a core made of graphite powder and clay.
cards.body_zh: 大英百科說：鉛筆是一根細細的石墨條，大家常叫它「鉛」，其實裡面完全沒有鉛這種金屬；現在的鉛筆仍然用石墨和黏土的混合物。教育部辭典的說法一樣：「石墨粉和黏土製成的筆心」。

cards.k: H and B · H 和 B
cards.en: The letters on the side
cards.body_en: One pencil maker explains the letters this way: H is for hard and B is for black, so HB means hard black, a medium-soft grade that the maker calls ideal for writing. The more clay in the core, the harder the pencil. The more graphite, the softer and blacker the line.
cards.body_zh: 一家鉛筆製造商這樣解釋筆桿上的字母：H 是 hard（硬），B 是 black（黑），所以 HB 是「又硬又黑」，屬於中等偏軟的等級，製造商說它最適合寫字。筆芯裡黏土越多，鉛筆越硬；石墨越多，線就越軟、越黑。

cards.en: Hard pen first, brush as helper
cards.body_en: Taiwan's Mandarin curriculum says Grades 1 and 2 practice hard-pen writing, and Grades 3 to 6 also learn the brush. Its teaching notes describe four steps for both tools: tracing over a red model, copying from a model beside you, writing on your own, and using your writing in real life.
cards.body_zh: 國語文課綱說：一、二年級以習寫硬筆字為主，三到六年級兼習毛筆字。課綱的教學說明還提到，硬筆和毛筆的寫字教學都有四個階段：描紅、臨摹、自運、應用——照著紅字描，看著範本寫，自己寫，最後用在生活裡。

cards.k: The National Contest · 全國語文競賽
cards.en: Fifty characters in fifty minutes
cards.body_en: In the writing event of Taiwan's National Language Competition, every group writes regular script with a traditional brush: 50 characters in 50 minutes. Students write characters 7 centimeters square. Half of the score is for brushwork. The other half is for structure and layout.
cards.body_zh: 全國語文競賽的「寫字」項目，各組一律用傳統毛筆寫楷書：50 分鐘寫 50 個字。學生組的字是 7 公分見方。評分一半看筆法，另一半看「結構與章法」。

myths.myth_en: If you practice the brush, your pencil writing will surely get better.
myths.myth_zh: 練了毛筆字，鉛筆字一定會變好。
myths.fact_en: We could not find a study that proves this. What the two tools share is stroke order and structure. Getting better with a pencil still takes practice with a pencil.
myths.fact_zh: 我們找不到研究能證明這件事。兩種筆共用的是筆順和結構；鉛筆字要進步，還是得用鉛筆練。

myths.myth_en: The dark core of a pencil is made of lead.
myths.myth_zh: 鉛筆的筆芯是鉛做的。
myths.fact_en: It is graphite mixed with clay. It contains no lead at all.
myths.fact_zh: 筆芯是石墨混合黏土做的，裡面完全沒有鉛。

myths.myth_en: Good handwriting means beautiful handwriting.
myths.myth_zh: 字寫得好，就是寫得漂亮。
myths.fact_en: Taiwan's curriculum puts correct first, then upright, then neat. Beautiful comes last.
myths.fact_zh: 課綱的順序是：先正確，再端正，然後工整，最後才是美觀。

myths.myth_en: The more times you copy a character, the better.
myths.myth_zh: 同一個字抄越多遍越好。
myths.fact_en: The curriculum says writing practice should be about quality, and it warns against practicing too much.
myths.fact_zh: 課綱說，寫字的練習「應以質為主要考量，避免過度練習」。

tricks.body_en: The structure is still there.
tricks.body_zh: 結構還在。

tricks.body_en: Brush or pencil, five strokes for 永.
tricks.body_zh: 毛筆、鉛筆，「永」都是五筆。

tricks.title_en: Start and end on the grid
tricks.body_en: Look first, then write.
tricks.body_zh: 先看，再寫。

tricks.body_en: In that order.
tricks.body_zh: 照這個順序。

safety.en: A sharp pencil has a point. Walk with the point down, and never point it at a classmate.
safety.zh: 削尖的鉛筆有尖端：拿著走路時筆尖朝下，不要對著同學。

safety.en: Do not chew your pencil or put it in your mouth.
safety.zh: 不要咬鉛筆，也不要把鉛筆放進嘴裡。

safety.en: Sit up, and keep your eyes 35 to 45 centimeters from the paper. That is the distance Taiwan's government suggests for children.
safety.zh: 坐正，眼睛離紙 35 到 45 公分。這是政府給小朋友的護眼建議。

safety.en: After 30 minutes of close work, rest your eyes for 10 minutes. Make sure the light is bright enough.
safety.zh: 近距離用眼 30 分鐘，就休息 10 分鐘。光線要充足。

safety.en: If you use a real brush for the activities, wear old clothes and cover the desk with newspaper.
safety.zh: 活動如果用真的毛筆：穿舊衣服，桌上先鋪報紙。

materials.en: A brush with clean water and newspaper (or a thick marker) for each pair
materials.zh: 每兩人一枝毛筆、清水和舊報紙（或一枝粗的麥克筆）

materials.en: A sheet with one 10-cm square and one 2-cm square, each with a cross inside, and a pencil
materials.zh: 一張畫了 10 公分方格和 2 公分方格的紙（格子裡都畫十字），還有鉛筆

steps.en: With the brush, write 永 in the big square. Watch the cross: which strokes touch the center line?
steps.zh: 用毛筆在大格子裡寫「永」。看著十字線：哪幾筆碰到中線？

steps.en: With the pencil, write 永 in the small square, in the same stroke order.
steps.zh: 用鉛筆在小格子裡寫「永」，筆順要一樣。

steps.en: Mark the start and the end of every stroke with a dot, in both characters.
steps.zh: 在兩個字上，把每一筆的起點和終點各點一個點。

steps.en: Compare with your partner. Are the dots in the same parts of the two squares?
steps.zh: 和同伴比一比：兩個格子裡，那些點是不是落在同樣的地方？

activities.tip_en: The two characters do not have to be beautiful. You are checking positions, not beauty.
activities.tip_zh: 兩個字都不必漂亮。這裡要檢查的是位置，不是美不美。

materials.en: Squared paper, a pencil, and an eraser for each student
materials.zh: 每人一張有格子的紙、鉛筆和橡皮擦

materials.en: A model character on the board, such as 山, 水, or 春
materials.zh: 黑板上的一個範字，例如「山」「水」「春」

steps.en: Copy the model once, as correctly as you can.
steps.zh: 先照著範字寫一次，越正確越好。

steps.en: Copy it again, and this time change one stroke on purpose: make it too short, too long, or move it.
steps.zh: 再寫一次，這次故意把其中一筆改掉：太短、太長，或移個位置。

steps.en: Swap papers. Circle the stroke your partner changed, and say what is wrong with it in English.
steps.zh: 和同伴交換。把他改掉的那一筆圈起來，用英文說它哪裡不對。

steps.en: Useful sentences: “This stroke is too short.” “This stroke is in the wrong position.”
steps.zh: 可以用的句子：“This stroke is too short.”、“This stroke is in the wrong position.”

activities.tip_en: Small changes are harder to find. Start with big ones.
activities.tip_zh: 改得越少越難找。先從明顯的開始。

sources.en: Mandarin curriculum, Grades 3 to 6: learn the structure and write correct, neat hard-pen characters (4-Ⅱ-6, 4-Ⅲ-4); hard-pen writing first, brush as helper (4-Ⅱ-7, 4-Ⅲ-5)
sources.zh: 十二年國教國語文領綱：4-Ⅱ-6「掌握偏旁變化和間架結構要領書寫正確及工整的硬筆字」、4-Ⅱ-7「習寫以硬筆字為主，毛筆為輔，掌握楷書筆畫的書寫方法」（4-Ⅲ-4、4-Ⅲ-5 同一方向）
sources.src: 教育部《國語文課程綱要》（107 年），p. 11

sources.en: Grades 1 and 2: good posture and tidy writing habits (4-Ⅰ-4); basic strokes and stroke order (4-Ⅰ-5)
sources.zh: 4-Ⅰ-4「養成良好的書寫姿勢，並保持整潔的書寫習慣」、4-Ⅰ-5「認識基本筆畫、筆順，掌握運筆原則，寫出正確及工整的國字」
sources.src: 教育部《國語文課程綱要》（107 年），p. 10

sources.en: Teaching notes: hard pen first, brush as helper; Grades 1 and 2 practice hard-pen writing, and Grades 3 to 6 also learn the brush
sources.zh: 「寫字應以硬筆為主，毛筆為輔，依序安排基本筆畫、筆順、間架結構等練習……第一學習階段以習寫硬筆字為主，第二、三學習階段兼習毛筆字」
sources.src: 教育部《國語文課程綱要》實施要點，p. 26

sources.en: Square sizes: 1.5 to 2 cm for hard-pen writing in Grades 1 and 2; 8 to 12 cm for large brush characters, on a nine-square, 米, or 田 grid
sources.zh: 「硬筆字之練習，第一學習階段，格子的大小，以1.5-2公分見方為原則……練習大楷毛筆字，格子的大小，以8-12公分見方為原則，可採用九宮格、米字格或田字格」
sources.src: 教育部《國語文課程綱要》實施要點，p. 50

sources.en: Quality over quantity; correct first, then upright, then neat, and beautiful last; tracing, copying, writing on your own, and using
sources.zh: 「寫字的練習應以質為主要考量，避免過度練習。除正確性外，優先考慮形體端正，次之強調工整，最後強調美觀」；「硬筆、毛筆寫字教學，應就描紅、臨摹、自運與應用等不同學習階段，做適切的安排」
sources.src: 教育部《國語文課程綱要》實施要點，p. 52

sources.en: 間架: the stroke structure of a character
sources.zh: 間架：「文字的筆畫結構或文章的布局。」
sources.src: 教育部《重編國語辭典修訂本》「間架」

sources.en: 筆順: the order in which strokes are written
sources.zh: 筆順：「書寫文字時，筆畫先後的順序，稱為『筆順』。」
sources.src: 教育部《重編國語辭典修訂本》「筆順」

sources.en: 九宮格: ruled paper for copying, each square divided into nine; 田 and 米 grids do the same job
sources.zh: 九宮格：「臨帖所用的界格紙。每一大格用『井』字形劃分為九小格，以便於臨摹時對照範本字形、掌握點劃部位。另有田字格、米字格等，功用相當。」
sources.src: 教育部《重編國語辭典修訂本》「九宮格」

sources.en: 臨摹: two ways to learn, copying with the paper beside a model and tracing with the paper over it
sources.zh: 臨摹：「學習書法的兩種方法。臨是置紙於旁而模仿碑帖，摹則以紙覆於範帖上而描摹。」
sources.src: 教育部《重編國語辭典修訂本》「臨摹」

sources.en: 描紅: characters printed in red on practice paper, traced stroke by stroke
sources.zh: 描紅：「用紅色將字套印在習字紙上，用墨筆按照紅字範本一點一畫依樣描寫。」
sources.src: 教育部《重編國語辭典修訂本》「描紅」

sources.en: 鉛筆: a core made of graphite powder and clay
sources.zh: 鉛筆：「石墨粉和黏土製成的筆心，嵌在木質或其他質料的筆管中，多半為細圓條形。」
sources.src: 教育部《重編國語辭典修訂本》「鉛筆」

sources.en: A pencil is a slender rod of graphite, often called the “lead,” though it contains none of that metal; modern pencils still use a mixture of graphite and clay
sources.zh: 鉛筆是細細的石墨條，常被叫做「鉛」，其實不含鉛；現代鉛筆仍用石墨與黏土的混合物
sources.src: Encyclopaedia Britannica, “pencil”

sources.en: B = Black, HB = Hard Black, H = Hard; the more clay, the harder the pencil; the more graphite, the softer and blacker
sources.zh: B＝Black、HB＝Hard Black、H＝Hard；黏土越多越硬，石墨越多越軟越黑
sources.src: STAEDTLER, “Pencils and accessories”

sources.en: National Language Competition (2026), writing event: traditional brush, regular script, 50 characters in 50 minutes; 7-cm characters for student groups; brushwork 50%, structure and layout 50%
sources.zh: 「寫字：各組均限50分鐘」「一律以傳統毛筆書寫楷書」「國小學生組、國中學生組、高中學生組均為7公分見方」「各組字數均為50字」；評分「筆法：占50％」「結構與章法：占50％」
sources.src: 教育部《中華民國115年全國語文競賽實施要點》

sources.en: Eye care for children: rest 10 minutes after 30 minutes; sit correctly when writing; keep 35 to 45 cm away
sources.zh: 「用眼30分鐘，休息10分鐘。」「讀書光線要充足，寫字時的坐姿要正確，閱讀保持35-45公分距離。」
sources.src: 行政院兒童網「護眼6招」

sources.en: Stroke order: 17 basic rules, summed up from the Ministry of Education's handbook
sources.zh: 「依據教育部《常用國字標準字體筆順手冊》基本法則，歸納的筆順基本法則有17條」
sources.src: 教育部《國字標準字體筆順學習網》

recap.en: The whole road, from the first brush to your own pencil
recap.zh: 從第一枝毛筆，走到你手上的鉛筆
recap.lead_en: This is the last lesson in the series. Here are all fifteen, with one sentence each. Tap any lesson to go back.
recap.lead_zh: 這是這個系列的最後一課。十五堂課各用一句話回顧，點任何一課都可以回去看。

items.en: Brush, ink, paper, and inkstone: the four tools of writing.
items.zh: 筆、墨、紙、硯：寫字的四樣工具。

items.en: Press for thick, lift for thin.
items.zh: 按下去就粗，提起來就細。

items.en: The character 永 holds eight basic strokes.
items.zh: 一個「永」字，藏著八種基本筆法。

items.en: Stroke order gives everyone the same path through a character.
items.zh: 筆順讓每個人用同一條路線寫一個字。

items.en: Characters began as pictures on bones and bronze.
items.zh: 文字從甲骨和青銅器上的圖畫開始。

items.en: Clerical script flattened the curves and added the swallow tail.
items.zh: 隸書把彎的拉直，還多了一個燕尾。

items.en: Regular, running, and cursive: one character, three speeds.
items.zh: 楷、行、草：同一個字，三種速度。

items.en: Wang Xizhi wrote 之 twenty times, and no two are alike.
items.zh: 王羲之寫了二十個「之」，沒有兩個一樣。

items.en: Yan's muscle and Liu's bone: same strokes, different pressure.
items.zh: 顏筋柳骨：筆畫一樣，輕重不同。

items.en: The treasures are in Taipei, resting in dim light.
items.zh: 國寶就在台北，在暗暗的燈光下休息。

items.en: A spring couplet has an upper line, a lower line, and a banner across the top.
items.zh: 春聯有上聯、下聯，上面還有一張橫批。

items.en: A seal is carved backward so that it prints the right way around.
items.zh: 印章要反著刻，蓋出來才是正的。

items.en: Copying a sutra: one character in each square, slowly and evenly.
items.zh: 抄經：一格一個字，慢慢地、均勻地寫。

items.en: A brush changes its line by pressure; a broad-edge pen, by direction.
items.zh: 毛筆的粗細看輕重，平頭筆的粗細看方向。

items.en: Take the thickness away, and the structure is still there.
